decisions.reason: As a newly launched, close-to-core Magento shop template with low carrying cost, it is still a worthwhile option to keep while demand becomes clearer, even if its narrow scope raises some exit risk.
A responsive website template fits the firm’s existing hosting and website customer base and is inexpensive to leave on the market, so the option value still exceeds the likely carrying cost.
Premium customer support is highly complementary to the firm’s service-led positioning and 24/7 expertise, making it a strong core extension rather than an option to abandon soon.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm’s technical know-how and hosting operations, and its own page suggests enough commitment to continue while market feedback develops.

Although this data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core business and competes with many other options for attention, it is still a young digital product line whose uncertainty likely justifies keeping it for now.
